notes: IQ-05 round 2, variant A (DEC-027): 20 visible rows. Everything else is config_pilot_2014_2021_base.json.

board: 6 px between bars (C2-2: 22) and name and value text up to 0.78 of the bar height (C2-2: 0.56 / 0.54), namescale 1.0 (config.json: 0.88), so the text is as large as 20 rows allow: 29 px names and values on the 1920 frame, against 32 px names in the top ten.

palette (DEC-029): up to 22 drivers can be on screen together on a 20-row board (20 rows plus rows still fading out), against 12 on the top ten. The colour rule is NOT weakened: 22 colours, every pair at least CIEDE2000 18.2 apart as drawn (rule: 18), white names at least 3.2:1 on every bar. Keeping the 12 top-ten colours and adding 10 would only reach 14.6, so this is a separate palette: a driver's colour in A differs from B and from the full video. Vivid colours first; the last few (olive, taupe, grey-green, grey) are used only when 20+ drivers need colours at once.
